pure-announcement.rationale: Beneath the marketing framing there is a transferable pipeline shape — hook-driven auto-capture, session-stop consolidation into semantic memory, budget-gated hybrid recall — that a reader could replicate outside this product.

duplicate.rationale: The nearest concept, knowledge-lifecycle-management, covers claim confidence, supersession and decay once knowledge already exists in the base; it says nothing about the hook-based auto-capture mechanism or budget-gated injection at session start that this note centers on, so a reader learns something new here even though the consolidation step overlaps.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The pipeline shape (12 lifecycle hooks, LLM-driven consolidation on session stop, hybrid BM25+vector+graph recall) is described as a concrete, checkable mechanism, not an unsourced claim.

durability.rationale: This landing page is dominated by exactly the perishable categories the original source was parked for — a pinned version (v0.9.29), port numbers, test counts, a competitor benchmark table, and Product Hunt testimonials — with the durable pipeline shape present but a small fraction of the text, so it does not clear the bar the original source failed.

actionability.rationale: A reader can replicate the concrete architecture regardless of this product: wire capture to agent lifecycle events, consolidate raw observations into semantic memory with dedup and decay on session end, and inject top-ranked results under a token budget at the next session start.

atomicity.rationale: The capture-consolidate-recall pipeline is one coherent mechanism statable in a single paragraph, independent of the page's feature-by-feature marketing framing.
